_note: The Disasters category (Kevin, 2026-11-23): kind → cause → type, as in pipelines/common/event_categories.py (VOCAB 'disaster', DISASTER_TYPES). Names follow the IRDR peril classification as EM-DAT uses it: Integrated Research on Disaster Risk (2014), Peril classification and hazard glossary (IRDR DATA Publication No. 1); EM-DAT's classification tree as updated in September 2023 (https://doc.emdat.be/docs/data-structure-and-content/disaster-classification-system/, read 2026-11-23). 'emdat' gives the EM-DAT group > subgroup > type each value matches; 'note' says where we merge or rename. 'wikidata' is the matching Wikidata class (checked against Wikidata's labels, 2026-11-23). Facet values have no ids field, so the ids live here, not in the timelines.

natural.name: Natural
natural.irdr: the six natural families: geophysical, hydrological, meteorological, climatological, biological, extra-terrestrial

human-caused.name: Human-caused
human-caused.note: Renamed: EM-DAT's 'Technological' group plus famines caused by policy or war (EM-DAT's former 'Complex' group, removed in 2023), and nuclear tests, which EM-DAT doesn't record.

eruption.name: Volcanic activity
eruption.note: The id stays 'eruption' (Kevin's word); the name is EM-DAT's type.

earthquake.name: Earthquake or tsunami
earthquake.emdat: Natural > Geophysical > Earthquake (subtypes: Ground movement; Tsunami)
earthquake.note: Renamed: EM-DAT's 'Earthquake' type, named with its tsunami subtype so a reader finds tsunamis here (Kevin, 2026-11-23).

storm.name: Storm
storm.emdat: Natural > Meteorological > Storm (incl. Tropical cyclone, Tornado, Blizzard/Winter storm)

drought.name: Drought or crop failure
drought.note: Renamed and merged: EM-DAT's 'Drought', plus famines with no policy or war cause (EM-DAT reclassified most famines as drought in 2023).

mass-movement.name: Mass movement
mass-movement.emdat: Natural > Geophysical > Mass movement (dry); Natural > Hydrological > Mass movement (wet)
mass-movement.note: Merged: EM-DAT's dry and wet mass movements (landslide, avalanche, mudslide, rockfall) as one type (Kevin, 2026-11-23).

extreme-temperature.name: Extreme temperature
extreme-temperature.note: Includes a volcanic winter (a cascade: the eruption is the main category when it is the event).

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.note: Natural even when people lit it, as EM-DAT files wildfires; a town burning is an Urban fire.

impact.name: Impact or space weather
impact.emdat: Natural > Extra-terrestrial > Impact; Natural > Extra-terrestrial > Space weather

mass-extinction.name: Mass extinction
mass-extinction.emdat: none (EM-DAT records disasters to people, not extinctions)
mass-extinction.note: Added: no IRDR or EM-DAT class (Kevin, 2026-11-23). Wikidata extinction event (label checked 2026-11-23). The Earth and Life extinctions; the K-Pg extinction also carries impact.

infestation.name: Infestation
infestation.note: Kept apart from Epidemic, as EM-DAT does (locusts); an animal epidemic (rinderpest) is an Epidemic.

famine.name: Famine
famine.emdat: none since 2023 (the former 'Complex' group; now an 'Associated disaster' tag)
famine.note: Only a famine caused mainly by policy or war (Kevin, 2026-11-23); one classed as genocide also carries 'Massacre or genocide'.

transport.name: Transport accident
transport.note: Air, rail, road, water and space (EM-DAT has no space subtype).

collapse.name: Structural collapse
collapse.emdat: Technological > Industrial accident > Collapse (Industrial); Technological > Miscellaneous accident > Collapse (Miscellaneous)
collapse.note: Merged: EM-DAT's industrial and miscellaneous collapses (dams, buildings, bridges, spoil tips).

urban-fire.name: Urban fire
urban-fire.note: A town or city burning; human-caused or of unknown cause (EM-DAT files fires as technological).

spill.name: Spill or pollution
spill.emdat: Technological > Industrial accident > Oil spill; Chemical spill; Poisoning
spill.note: Merged: EM-DAT's spills and poisoning; adds pollution events (the Great Smog), which EM-DAT doesn't record.

crowd-crush.name: Crowd crush
crowd-crush.note: Its own type (Kevin, 2026-11-23); EM-DAT files crushes as miscellaneous accidents.

accident.name: Accident or explosion
accident.emdat: Technological > Miscellaneous accident > Explosion (Miscellaneous); Industrial accident > Explosion (Industrial)
accident.note: EM-DAT's 'Miscellaneous accident' other than collapses, fires and crushes, which have their own types: chiefly explosions. Transport accidents (EM-DAT's 'Transport': air, rail, road, water) have their own type, Transport accident.

nuclear-test.name: Nuclear test
nuclear-test.emdat: none (EM-DAT records accidents, not tests; nearest: Industrial accident > Radiation)
nuclear-test.note: Added: no IRDR or EM-DAT class (Kevin, 2026-11-23).
